meta.title: Progressive Vocabulary
meta.description: A 6-level vocabulary learning system that grows with the user. Motor memory is protected, word positions never change, and progression is driven by real usage.

hero.title: Progressive Vocabulary
hero.description: A structured 6-level vocabulary system that grows with the communicator. Words unlock through genuine use, positions never move, and each level builds naturally on the one before.

heroScreenshot.label: Progressive Vocabulary - Settings
heroScreenshot.description: Progressive vocabulary settings with level controls and display options

principle.title: The Core Principle
principle.description: Use words to unlock more words. Students start at Level 1 with a small set of essential words. As they demonstrate consistent use, the system tracks progress and unlocks the next level without moving any existing words.

items.title: Motor Memory Protection
items.description: Words never change position once introduced. A symbol at row 2, column 3 at Level 1 stays there through Level 6.

items.title: Per-Level Evaluation
items.description: Only words introduced at the current level count toward advancement. Previously mastered words do not inflate progress.

items.title: Usage-Driven Advancement
items.description: Words become mastered only after being tapped the required number of times. The system measures genuine use, not just exposure.

items.title: Ghost Slots
items.description: Locked words render as non-interactive ghost cells - visible but not tappable. Learners see what is coming without being overwhelmed.

levels.title: Six Levels of Growth
levels.subtitle: Each level has its own threshold and mastery requirement. Thresholds decrease at higher levels because the word pools grow larger.
levels.footnote: Level 5 is the automatic advancement ceiling, where all words are visible. Level 6 is not earned through usage; it is unlocked manually by a caregiver in admin settings.

readiness.title: The Floating Readiness Button
readiness.description: A floating action button on the main screen gives the communicator live progress feedback. Its colour and badge update automatically as words are used. Tapping it opens the Readiness Check Modal with full stats.

fabStates.label: In Progress
fabStates.description: Progress below 75% - the FAB shows the current completion percentage in blue.

fabStates.label: Almost There
fabStates.description: Progress above 75% but not yet ready - the FAB turns orange to signal that the user is close.

fabStates.label: Ready!
fabStates.description: All required words are mastered - the FAB turns green and can pulse to invite advancement.

modal.title: Readiness Check Modal
modal.description: When the user taps the FAB, the Readiness Check Modal shows a detailed breakdown of progress toward the next level.

items.label: Progress circle
items.detail: Shows percentage toward the next level

items.label: Status title
items.detail: Keep Going, Making Progress, Almost There, or You're Ready

items.label: Stats row
items.detail: Words used, words mastered, and total taps

items.label: Practice recommendations
items.detail: Up to 12 words that still need more taps

items.label: Unlock button
items.detail: Appears only when the threshold is met

gridSizes.title: Grid-Size Independent Progression
gridSizes.description: In Core-Fringe mode, progression is scoped to the symbols placed on the active grid layout. Each grid size has its own pool, so switching grid sizes switches the progression pool independently.

adminControls.title: Caregiver Configuration
adminControls.subtitle: All progression settings live in the Admin screen under Language -> Progressive Vocabulary. Each setting is per-user, so different communicators can have different mastery requirements.

items.label: Enable Progression
items.description: Toggle the entire system on or off. When off, all symbols are visible.

items.label: Show Ghost Slots
items.description: Display locked word positions as ghosted previews with lock icons.

items.label: Mastery Threshold
items.description: Adjust the percentage of words that must be mastered (50-100% in 5% steps).

items.label: Min Uses Per Word
items.description: Adjust how many times each word must be tapped to count as mastered (1-10).

items.label: Expert Vocabulary
items.description: Unlocks Level 6 words. Only appears at Level 5 and above, and remains a manual caregiver decision.

items.label: Reset Progression
items.description: Resets all words back to Level 1 and requires confirmation.

wordFinder.title: Locked Words Are Clearly Marked
wordFinder.description: Word Finder searches the entire vocabulary but shows locked words as unavailable, each labelled with 'Available at Level X'. Tapping a locked result does nothing. Once the user advances, the same result becomes selectable.
items: Search results are sorted with unlocked words first
Locked results show the required level, not just a padlock
Step-by-step guidance cannot activate a locked cell
Updates instantly when a new level is unlocked
